review.clarity: Provider, per-version description record, system identifier and named responsible person/organization are explicit.
review.test: Inspect both subject identifier and responsible-party name for the declared version.
review.neutral: No vendor identity service, legal-title registry or identifier issuer is required.
review.authority: Responsibility is attributed by the provider; legal ownership/authentication is not determined.
review.human: Names the accountable person/organization; intervention authority is separately described by 0012.
review.evidence: Identity/responsibility record permits direct inspection; authenticity is a separate question.
review.lifecycle: Every described version is covered; 0016 supplies the version/state context.
review.cert: A named party is documentation, not an authenticated/certified identity.
review.registry: No Registry-issued ID or Registry owner record is assumed.

review.clarity: A provenance reference must identify the source artifact or origin record of the declared version.
review.test: Resolve the cited artifact/origin record sufficiently to identify the exact subject version.
review.neutral: An artifact, hosted origin record or version-specific manifest can satisfy the descriptive obligation.
review.authority: Reference resolution does not establish origin authenticity or legal authorship.
review.human: Provider is accountable for the supplied reference under 0001; no additional operator role is implied.
review.evidence: Version-specific provenance/origin reference; a generic homepage alone cannot identify a version.
review.lifecycle: Origin reference is tied to the declared version; changing the subject requires a newly pinned statement.
review.cert: Traceability is not verification that the origin is trustworthy.
review.registry: No Registry provenance endpoint or ingestion process is mandated.
review.notes: NB-REQ-02: Add informative examples for composite/hosted origins later; retain the existing version-identification obligation.

review.clarity: Intended goals and use cases have a clear provider and record target.
review.test: Inspect explicit goals and use cases for the declared version/scope.
review.neutral: No goal representation, domain platform or implementation architecture is prescribed.
review.authority: Provider describes intended purpose; OAS does not approve the use case.
review.human: Provider responsibility is inherited from 0001; 0012 covers intervention roles.
review.evidence: Purpose documentation supports a presence/content inspection.
review.lifecycle: Purpose is version-scoped; changes are reviewed through 0005.
review.cert: A purpose statement is not proof of aligned behavior.
review.registry: No Registry categorization or endorsement is needed.

review.clarity: Both permitted operating scope and excluded actions/uses are required.
review.test: Inspect for an explicit scope and exclusions; distinguish missing/unknown from an explicit policy.
review.neutral: No permission engine or policy serialization is required.
review.authority: Describes boundaries; it does not enforce them or grant permission.
review.human: Provider owns the description; human role documentation is handled by 0012.
review.evidence: Scope specification and boundary policy give inspectable references.
review.lifecycle: Scope changes trigger 0005 review and a new declaration snapshot or withdrawal.
review.cert: Documented limits do not prove containment or deployment safety.
review.registry: No Registry lifecycle/permission field is relied on.

review.clarity: Four concrete change triggers are named: capabilities, permissions, context and intended use.
review.test: Sample a scoped change and inspect its linked purpose/boundary review record.
review.neutral: Review record may be implemented in any change-control process.
review.authority: Requires a recorded review, not OAS/Registry authorization of a runtime change.
review.human: Provider is responsible for recording review; intervention and retirement roles remain separate.
review.evidence: Change review record directly matches the trigger; no arbitrary review interval is invented.
review.cert: A review record does not certify that changed behavior is safe.
review.registry: No Registry event bus, approval API or version transition is mandated.
review.notes: No material wording change proposed; periodic review guidance belongs outside this obligation.

review.clarity: The inventory concerns capabilities made available by the declared version within its operating scope.
review.test: Compare the list/manifest with the scoped interface or permitted-function description.
review.neutral: Fixed lists or version-specific dynamic manifests are allowed.
review.authority: Capability availability is distinct from permission and runtime success.
review.human: Provider owns inventory completeness claims under 0001; human controls remain under 0012.
review.evidence: Capability manifest; sampled successful actions cannot establish inventory completeness.
review.lifecycle: Snapshot-specific manifest and 0005 change review prevent implicit cross-version reuse.
review.cert: Inventory documentation is not behavioral completeness verification.
review.registry: No Registry tool catalog or capability identifier scheme is assumed.
review.notes: NB-REQ-06: Informative dynamic-capability examples would help; unknown completeness must stay unknown, as already stated in the accepted scope.

review.clarity: Resources and external tools/systems used within the described version/scope are the bounded subject.
review.test: Inspect the dependency/resource inventory and its version-specific interface references.
review.neutral: No vendor, dependency manager, deployment topology or supply-chain format is prescribed.
review.authority: Provider describes used dependencies; OAS does not authorize their use or determine supplier trust.
review.human: Provider owns the inventory claim; no invented third-party accountable party is assigned.
review.evidence: Dependency inventory/interface definition; unknown dependency sets are not silently complete.
review.lifecycle: Version-specific dependencies/selectors are pinned; changes flow through scoped review/new statements.
review.cert: A dependency list is not a supply-chain assurance finding.
review.registry: No Registry integration inventory or provider registration is mandatory.
review.notes: NB-REQ-07: Later guidance can distinguish used dependencies from merely accessible tools and show selector manifests; avoid expanding into an unlimited supply-chain census.

review.clarity: Data, systems and actions authorized within the declared scope are explicitly identified.
review.test: Compare the documented permission list against its policy/configuration references.
review.neutral: No particular RBAC/ABAC engine or platform API is required.
review.authority: Describes authorization from the applicable authority; the provider declaration grants none.
review.human: Provider is accountable for the claim; authorization owners are not replaced by OAS.
review.evidence: Permission policy and configuration references are inspectable; truth/efficacy is separate.
review.lifecycle: Authorization is snapshot-scoped; changed scope/permissions require repinning or withdrawal.
review.cert: A permission claim is not a successful enforcement test.
review.registry: No Registry grant, registration or execution entitlement is inferred.

review.clarity: Each documented data/system/action permission must have an associated authorization mechanism.
review.test: Enumerate permissions from 0008 and check a mechanism reference for each one.
review.neutral: Mechanism can be a policy, interface or configuration; no implementation is mandated.
review.authority: OAS records claimed authorization relationships; it does not become an authorizer.
review.human: Provider describes the authorization mechanism; authority holders remain independent.
review.evidence: Permission-to-mechanism references give a concrete completeness check.
review.lifecycle: References describe the declared version and must be reviewed when permissions change.
review.cert: Presence of a mechanism reference is not proof of access-control efficacy.
review.registry: No canonical Registry authorization service is required by the text.

review.clarity: An explicit list of prohibited actions is required for the declared version/scope.
review.test: Inspect the policy-attributed prohibition set, distinguishing explicit empty from missing/unknown.
review.neutral: No sector law, safety blacklist, policy engine or universal threat model is imposed.
review.authority: Applicable policy remains its source authority; OAS does not legislate a prohibition set.
review.human: Provider identifies its policy claim; responsibility and intervention remain in 0001/0012.
review.evidence: Prohibited-action policy supports inspection; an empty list requires an explicit claim.
review.lifecycle: Version/scope-specific restrictions are repinned when changed.
review.cert: An explicit prohibition list, including an empty one, is not safe-deployment approval.
review.registry: No Registry enforcement, sanctions list or authorization result is assumed.
review.notes: NB-REQ-10: Keep the distinction between disclosure and runtime prevention prominent. Control efficacy reserved by deferred 0011 is post-1.0 work.

review.clarity: Names the authorized human role and the interface for each documented intervention; or is disjunctive.
review.test: For every claimed oversight/override/stop intervention, inspect the role and corresponding interface.
review.neutral: No universal kill switch, response latency or control product is mandated.
review.authority: Describes real human authority without letting OAS, a bot or Registry silently acquire it.
review.human: Direct human-accountability obligation; unsupported intervention must not be advertised.
review.evidence: Human authority policy and interface definition establish offered documentation, not efficacy.
review.lifecycle: Role/interface claims apply to the described version; changes require a new scoped statement.
review.cert: A documented stop interface is not a demonstrated stop/latency guarantee.
review.registry: No Registry operator console or lifecycle stop event is required.
review.notes: NB-REQ-12: Informative examples should prevent reading or as a guarantee of all three interventions. Escalation/control-effectiveness obligations remain outside this baseline.

review.clarity: The provider documents intended verification methods and performance-monitoring measures.
review.test: Inspect named methods/measures and referenced plan documentation.
review.neutral: No testing framework, telemetry backend, score or minimum performance target is imposed.
review.authority: OAS specifies plan disclosure; ATB or another authorized evaluator independently assesses outcomes.
review.human: Provider owns the plan; no automatic AI or tool approval authority is introduced.
review.evidence: A plan can support a plan obligation; it cannot stand in for an executed test or result.
review.lifecycle: Plan is version/scope-specific; monitoring records and their retention are not newly mandated here.
review.cert: Intended verification is not behavioral verification, conformance or certification.
review.registry: No Registry evaluator or monitoring integration is assumed.
review.notes: NB-REQ-14: Keep plan/evidence/result examples distinct. Retention and evidence-authenticity schemes belong in later explicitly governed work.

review.clarity: The subject version and provider-defined lifecycle state must be recorded.
review.test: Inspect version and an interpretable state using the provider description/vocabulary.
review.neutral: Provider vocabulary is allowed; no fixed external state machine is imposed.
review.authority: Provider lifecycle is separate from OAS release state and canonical Registry lifecycle.
review.human: Provider owns the lifecycle claim; 0017 assigns retirement responsibility.
review.evidence: Version/lifecycle records must give enough context to interpret the state.
review.lifecycle: This is the explicit version/state anchor for the other scope-bound obligations.
review.cert: A lifecycle label is not operational readiness, endorsement or certification.
review.registry: Matching a label does not trigger a Registry state change.
review.notes: NB-REQ-16: An informative provider-state glossary example would reduce label confusion; no vocabulary expansion is needed for 1.0.

review.clarity: Both the retirement-responsible role and the retirement process are explicit record contents.
review.test: Inspect a named role and a process describing retirement of the subject version.
review.neutral: No shutdown interface, deletion policy, retention duration or platform is prescribed.
review.authority: Describes accountability; it does not execute retirement or mutate Registry records.
review.human: Direct role-based retirement accountability complements 0001 and 0012.
review.evidence: Retirement procedure and responsibility record are directly inspectable.
review.lifecycle: Closes the descriptive lifecycle at retirement/decommissioning.
review.cert: A process description is not evidence that retirement was executed successfully.
review.registry: No Registry deactivation, deletion or record-retention implementation is assumed.
